○ A little about me

The question
behind the work.

✳

How do you take something complicated and make it useful to someone?

That question has followed me from financial-data products at Okra to enterprise AI at Barrel and inbound operations at Amazon. I enjoy getting close to a workflow, understanding where it breaks down, and working with technical teams to make it better.

I’m now pursuing my MBA at Cornell and learning to build software with AI coding tools. Echo and Dockflow are part of that learning: concrete projects where I can explain the decisions, test the behavior, and be clear about what still needs work.
